procedure.method: Fresh independent critic in this turn; no spawn, resume, fork, peer review, producer inspection, or unlisted path read. Read the pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, addendum and compact method/adapter. Verified exact input hashes/byte counts and read all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded paths. The packet declares zero source assets and zero protected layouts. Sequentially opened and visually inspected the exact files using tools.view_image with detail original, forwarding each returned image to this session: R15-C1-M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4, M5 in the same three-view order. All fifteen images were actually displayed before beginning any copy-reading/transcription, judgment or score. Then read each image's eleven entries in packet order from the displayed pixels, retaining soft wraps and meaningful word spaces. No OCR, generated assets, resized replacements or copy inferred from required text. No genuine unresolved glyph-class ambiguity required a revisit. Actual image headers and manifest/packet dimensions agree; each usage image is 720x405, each thumbnail 320x180, all RGB. Native 1672x940 for M1 and 1672x941 for M2-M5 are rounded 16:9, not mathematically exact; abs(height-width*9/16)=0.5 in every case. This is one independent portfolio judgment, not a three-critic aggregate.

ai_slop.location: accordion key pattern and sprigs along successive folds
ai_slop.observation: The musical object contains generic-looking uneven key bars, and similarly shaped sprigs decorate nearly every bend. These visible repetitions add polish without adding further event meaning; the local instrument construction remains an unresolved generated-looking detail.

residuals: Content_form and emotion_control scores 3: the salad/accordion/wave vocabulary feels broadly festive and lacks the specific adult social evening suggested by the copy.
Image_material and ai_slop scores 3: visible accordion key-bar spacing/length is weakly constructed compared with the more resolved salad.
Similar leaf sprigs recur across many ribbon bends, making the expressive system more decorative than specifically observed.
Native 1672x941 passes only the predeclared half-pixel single-edge rounding tolerance, not a mathematically exact 16:9 test.

recording_adapter.limit: Metadata bindings and attestations do not prove semantic viewing or source fidelity

evidence.observation: One continuous perspective courtyard scene surrounds a brush headline; the soup bowl dominates the near foreground and the flute player anchors the distant left. Text sits in two architectural light zones and two lower scene objects. This differs from M2's diagonal photo cuts and M3's overhead ring.

evidence.location: three diagonal photographic fields
evidence.observation: A food-serving close-up occupies upper left, an eye-level social scene upper right, and an extreme guitar crop spans the lower edge. The title is a black upper-right tab and the schedule a black lower-left wedge; practical copy crosses photo fields. Its asymmetric cut-and-overlap reading differs from M1's single scene and M4's isolated figures.

evidence.location: perimeter ring and central cream opening
evidence.observation: Overhead people, cups, food and a cropped drum make a radial border around a central serif title. The date is immediately above the title, venue and admission to its right, closing lines below-left. Its enclosing perimeter and uniform top-down crop differ from M1's depth scene and M5's directional ribbon paths, although central title/date relationships recur.

evidence.location: isolated figure groups around pale central field
evidence.observation: Large cutout social/serving/music vignettes occupy upper center, lower left and right edge. A small central heavy title connects separate information pockets in the pale gaps. Removing a continuous environment and using repeated figures creates a dispersed montage system, unlike M2's contiguous photographic polygons and M3's overhead circle; its finish is less distinctive than those differences in layout.

evidence.location: diagonal food/instrument crops and flowing text lobes
evidence.observation: A cropped salad fills bottom left, accordion top right, while colored ribbons bend between them and carry differently angled information. The oversized upper-left title, upper-middle schedule, middle-right venue and curved purchase line follow successive lobes. This produces a strongly directional graphic system unlike the central framed titles of M1/M3/M4.

residuals: Five distinct spatial/editing relationships are visible, sufficient for a diversity score of 4; the set is not exceptional because M1, M3 and M4 still repeat a central title/English/subtitle stack with date and venue nearby.
Food close-ups, spring greens and music objects recur across members. Their recurrence supplies content continuity but material or instrument changes alone are not the basis of the diversity score.
This diversity judgment covers all five; it does not cancel any member's lower dimension score or establish the other two critics' gates.
